metadata.scenario: An existing client contacts the office with an urgent need for service modification due to a critical situation. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is George Williams. I need to talk to you about my cardiac care services. It's urgent. Hi George, I remember you! What’s going on? Well, I had a slight setback this past week. My doctor mentioned I might need more frequent monitoring. I’m sorry to hear that. How can we adjust your services to better meet your needs? I think I need someone to check in on me at least every other day for cardiac care monitoring. Absolutely, I can arrange that. We can schedule you for cardiac care monitoring at $80 to $100 per visit. That sounds good, but can we also include medication management? I want to ensure I'm taking everything correctly. Yes, we offer medication management at $65 to $80 for a 30-45 minute visit. Would you like to add that service? Yes, please. I want to make sure I’m following the doctor’s orders precisely. Great choice, George. I’ll set up those visits for you. How about starting tomorrow? Tomorrow works. What time would the nurse be coming? We can have a nurse visit you at 10 AM. Does that work for your schedule? Yes, that’s perfect. I’ll also follow up with your insurance to confirm coverage for these additional services. That would be a relief. I was worried about the costs. I’ll ensure to keep you updated on that. Anything else you need while I have you on the line? No, I think that covers it. Thanks for being so responsive, Margaret. You’re welcome, George. I’ll send you a confirmation of tomorrow’s appointment and the care plan adjustments. Thank you! I really appreciate it. Of course! You take care, and we'll see you tomorrow. See you tomorrow. Goodbye! Goodbye, George!
